name: Bank of America
scale_note: Formed by the 1998 NationsBank–BankAmerica merger; the investment bank carries the Merrill heritage.
values: Realise the power of our people

process.notes: CV, short motivation questions and programme preference. Early applications are reviewed first.
Numerical, situational-judgement or game-based tests depending on the programme; check the careers page for the current format.
Recorded (HireVue-style) answers to motivation, competency and commercial-awareness questions; ~2 minutes per answer.
Back-to-back interviews with bankers, sometimes a group exercise or case; technicals appear here for IBD.

process.when: Typically within 2 weeks of the final round
process.notes: Spring-week converts to summer via an end-of-programme assessment at most banks.
